messages:
incident-bot: PAGER -> Elevated 5xx + client timeouts reported on streaming gateway (us-west-2). Start triage. Affected routes: /v1/stream, /v1/chat/stream. Visible symptoms: chunked responses ending early, ECONNRESET from gateway to clients, spikes in 504 and 502.

emma (oncall): I'm on it. Seeing a spike at 15:14 UTC, error rate ~12% on streaming endpoints. Non-streaming (paged) endpoints look fine. Marking customer-impact: likely degraded UX only (incomplete streams).

linda (sre): Which layer is failing? Proxy or runtime? Logs show proxy closing connection with 499/504 after 30s of no downstream ack. Collecting proxy and gateway logs now.

raj (eng-runtime): We just rolled a small perf kernel change to runtime 2h ago but only to dedicated capacity. This is hosted fleet. No runtime deploy on hosted in last 24h AFAIK. Could be nginx/gateway config or a network flakiness.

emma (oncall): Confirmed: no config deploys to gateway in last 60m. Traffic spike correlates with a large customer (org: 'streamshop') ramp.

carol (cust-success): Notified streamshop that we're investigating. They report many sessions that start and then close mid-response, user-visible truncation.

linda (sre): Repro: curling a long streaming request results in data chunks then connection resets. Snip of gateway log:
```
2026-03-15T15:16:12Z gateway[proxy-12]: upstream reset: connection closed by peer while sending response
2026-03-15T15:16:12Z gateway[proxy-12]: client 10.4.8.23 sent FIN
```

raj (eng-runtime): On runtime side metrics, we see steady token generation and KV cache hits — runtime didn't emit errors. Means connection drop likely at gateway/proxy or client aborts.

emma (oncall): Quick mitigations: 1) Increase gateway upstream timeout from 30s -> 60s temporarily. 2) Disable aggressive connection drain on the affected frontends. 3) Add a short-term fallback: for requests with ?stream=false route to paged endpoints. I'll run the first two.

linda (sre): +1 for increasing timeouts. Any risk of slow clients holding connections? We'll watch max concurrent connections and thread pools. If we extend timeouts, we may need to scale proxy workers.

emma (oncall): Executed: `kubectl patch configmap gateway-config -p '{"data":{"upstream_timeout":"60s","drain_timeout":"15s"}}'` — applying to us-west-2 canaries first. Rolling to 50% of frontends.

ops-bot: deploybot -> gateway-config patch rolled to 50% frontends (proxy-canary set). Observability: new config pushed.

carol (cust-success): Streamshop confirmed seeing fewer truncated sessions after 15:28 UTC. Partial improvement but not resolved.

raj (eng-runtime): Noted some clients still receiving early EOFs. Captured a sample TCP dump showing RSTs from proxy to client immediately after last chunk: `RST seq=...`. Could be connection buffer exhaustion on the proxy under sudden fanout.

linda (sre): I see proxy CPU climb on the canaries. Autoscaler not yet triggered due to pod CPU short spike. I'll scale gateway replicas by +30% in us-west-2.

emma (oncall): Scaled gateway replicas. Also enabled streaming keepalive probe tweak: `proxy.keepalive_idle=10s`. Hoping reduce idle drops.

raj (eng-runtime): As a safeguard, enabling fallback code path: when gateway sees repeated client cancels (>=3 per minute) for a given client IP, route new requests to paged endpoint and tag telemetry `fallback=paged`. Rolling out now.

incident-bot: PAGE -> Pager escalation threshold crossed (sustained 5xx >10% over 10m). Pager notified: oncall escalation to linda.

linda (sre): I'm taking lead. Next steps: 1) Keep increased upstream timeouts for 30 min and monitor. 2) Add a circuit-breaker on frontends to limit per-client concurrent streams to 4. 3) Investigate HTTP/1.1 chunked encoding handling in proxy — suspect truncation when buffer flush aligns with client cancels.

emma (oncall): Customer-impact update: streamshop degraded for ~20-30% of sessions earlier, now down to ~5% after fixes. No data loss beyond truncated responses.

carol (cust-success): I'll send a status note to the customer: interim mitigation in place, engineering investigating root cause, ETA for next update 30m.

raj (eng-runtime): Found a quirky edge where proxy's chunk coalescer merged trailing frame with `Content-Length` fallback, causing premature FIN when client cancels mid-chunk. Patch candidate: ensure chunked frames are flushed independently and gate FIN until idle. Preparing PR.

linda (sre): If the patch is safe, we can deploy to canaries after smoke tests. But short-term: continue scaling and keep fallback to paged for noisy clients. Also enabling extra tracing on gateway: `trace: stream_edge` artifacts for failures.

emma (oncall): Rolling the runtime-safe gateway patch to canaries now. smoke test: repeated long streams — canary passes 10/10. Rolling to 100% in 10m if metrics stable.

ops-bot: rollout -> gateway patch completed to 100% (us-west-2).

carol (cust-success): Customer update sent at 15:55 UTC. They acknowledged and observed improved behavior post-rollout.

linda (sre): Monitoring for 60m. If error rate stays <1% we'll close incident. Otherwise we'll reopen and continue deep-dive into client library behavior (some SDK versions may send premature FIN).

emma (oncall): Marking mitigation: increased timeouts, scaled frontends, keepalive tweak, client-fallback to paged, gateway chunk flush patch. Will file follow-up ticket to audit SDKs and add more robust metrics for client-cancel vs upstream-reset.

incident-bot: INCIDENT -> Mitigation in place, severity reduced to SEV3. Next update scheduled in 1h or on significant change.

linda (sre): Thanks all. Handoff to postmortem owners: @raj (eng-runtime) to own root-cause PR & SDK audit, @carol to own customer comms and SLA notes.

emma (oncall): Closing active on-call handoff. If anyone sees regression ping #incidents immediately. :thumbsup:
